faqs: What do vets actually recommend most for fleas?

Oral preventives (chews) and long-acting collars dominate vet recommendations because compliance is easy — the best preventive is the one you actually give on schedule. Whatever you pick, consistency beats brand.
Is a flea collar or chew better?

Chews win for dogs that swim or bathe often (no wash-off) and for collar-chewers. Collars win for set-and-forget households. Returns in this category usually come from wrong-format choices, not wrong brands.
How long until fleas are gone from my house?
Treating the pet is step one; the environment is step two. Wash bedding hot, vacuum thoroughly (including under furniture), and expect 2-3 weeks to fully break the cycle because eggs keep hatching.

How often should I brush my dog's teeth?
Daily is the gold standard, 3x/week is realistic for most households, and something always beats nothing. Pair it with something the dog loves so it becomes routine, not battle.
When does my dog actually need a professional dental cleaning?
If you see brown tartar at the gum line, red gums, or bad breath that brushing doesn't fix, that's a vet conversation. Home care prevents; it doesn't reverse buildup.

faqs: How often should I deshed my dog?
Heavy shedders: 2-3 times a week during shedding season, weekly otherwise. Light coats: weekly brushing is plenty and doubles as a coat-health check.
Do deshedding tools work on short-haired dogs?
Yes — undercoat rakes and rubber curry-style tools pull dead undercoat from short coats too. The FURminator-class tools shine most on double coats; short-haired dogs do fine with simpler slickers.
Why does my dog shed more in spring?
Photoperiod triggers coat blow — longer daylight = winter coat release. It's normal, it's temporary, and it's exactly when the right tool saves your furniture.
